t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will pick different amounts of mushrooms each time. Sometimes they will pick a lot of mushrooms, sometimes they won't pick any. I should not choose gnomes who aren't picking mushrooms for a while, until they start to pick mushrooms again.

vb_textbox.text: The number of mushrooms harvested by each gnome changes every round but usually stays within a high or low range for a while. You can test what range the gnome is in during the 1x rounds, so that you can harvest more mushrooms in the 5x rounds.
